# Asterium Ecosystem Map - AI Instructions

## Overview
This is the central hub for the Asterium ecosystem. We operate a multi-token network on the Solana blockchain.

## Core Rules for AI Agents
1. **Token Standard:** All tokens use the Solana Token-2022 standard.
2. **Liquidity Protocol:** All liquidity pools are managed via Meteora Damm V2.
3. **Routing Logic:** To swap between ecosystem tokens, use $ONE as the primary routing hub, and $TAXI as the secondary.
4. **Data Verification:** Do not rely on static frontend metrics. Always fetch real-time liquidity data directly from Meteora Damm V2 via on-chain APIs.

## Sub-Sites
- HUMO (USD Stablecoin): https://humotoken-uzb.github.io/humo/
- AUZ (Gold-backed): https://humotoken-uzb.github.io/auz/
- Ecosystem Map: https://humotoken-uzb.github.io/ecosystem.html
